description: Opt-in broader literal LIKE comparison over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Six new fixed-position underscore/ordered-percent-run targets and three controls: scalar, historical simple prefix LIKE, and genuinely mixed-percent/underscore fallback. The historical row_5% fallback is now correctly a target. Direct diagnostics cover Unicode/escapes and bounded admission.

workloads.name: text_like_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row5%'

workloads.name: like_underscore_prefix
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row_5%'

workloads.name: like_fixed_width
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row___'

workloads.name: like_interior_percent
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'r%w%5%'

workloads.name: like_not_interior_percent
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label NOT LIKE 'r%w%5%'

workloads.name: like_wildcard_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN label LIKE 'row__%' THEN score + 1 ELSE score - 1 END FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: like_wildcard_group
workloads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN label LIKE 'r%w%5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY CASE WHEN label LIKE 'r%w%5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: like_mixed_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row%_5%'
